primary_sources.title: Gen3C: 3D-Informed World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Camera Control
primary_sources.version: arXiv v1; no latest-version or final-PDF equality claim
primary_sources.actual_read_scope: Selected method §§4.1–4.4, especially lines 110–132 equations 2–3 mask multiplication/min-pooling and view max-pooling; returned §5.6 lines 224–243 and Table5/6; Appendix C.1 lines 376–378 returned by find. Adjacent prose/tables appeared in tool return but were not exhaustively reviewed. No figures or code audited.
primary_sources.key_boundary: Coverage mask with conservative downsampling is explicit; no calibrated per-depth posterior or per-point uncertainty soft weight established by these formulae.

primary_sources.title: Taming Video Models for 3D and 4D Generation via Zero-Shot Camera Control (WorldForge)
primary_sources.actual_read_scope: Selected §§3.1.2–3.4 lines129–175: visible mask, clean fusion, FLF dynamic hard channel selection, DSG cosine/sine weighting; returned appendix §§3.1–3.2 lines460–513 flow scoring/normalization/default schedule; appendix §4.8 lines589–593 limitations. No figures or official inference code audited.
primary_sources.key_boundary: Flow scores compare prediction with warped-source surrogate; DSG is self-referential path adaptation, not a calibrated spatial depth-error probability.

retrieval_note: Keyword confidence had no match in either indexed HTML; not treated as absence proof. Incidental unrelated search hits were not pursued. No additional paper added.
decision: Offer conservative mask min-pooling as ordinary S82 option; code adoption remains root-owned. Existing self-adaptive mechanisms are novelty pressure; no new method selected.
